notes: Live Shopify reads 25 Oct 2026 (sitemap_products_1.xml for discovery, /products/HANDLE.js or .oembed for price + per-variant availability). All six stores were reachable; none blocked. Parmore and Three Putt are GBP stores (Parmore currency per existing TGI research note; Three Putt currency confirmed GBP in .oembed), converted at 1.3375. Three Putt Golf Clothing store = threeputtgolfclothing.co.uk. Three Putt is print-on-demand: every image is a 'tapstitch' render/mockup, with no real photography. Their sweatshirt also comes in Black and Grey Marl but only the Cream render URL was confirmed, so Cream is listed. Parmore: several product images are AI-generated, judging by filenames ('GeneratedImage...', 'ChatGPTImage...'). I put the non-AI shots first on the cap and left out the AI ones where I could. The Parmore Graphic Tee (Black) has no product copy and only one 'Default Title' variant, so sizes are unknown. water when dry: I left out the ChatGPT_Image* files. The '-prop' packshots on the new FW26 utility pants and cap may be composited; I couldn't verify either way. Lots of WWD is sold out (Charcoal Hoodie, Camper Short Dusk, Logo Tee Black/Terracotta, 5-Panel Black, all Logo Quarter socks), and so is Public Drip's 'P' Script Nylon Snapback (Black). Weak spots in the sweep: (1) Rust/burnt-orange accent: nothing in stock in a true rust. The closest is HLS Society LS Tee in Vintage Brown; WWD Logo Tee Terracotta is sold out. (2) Socks: none in palette in stock at these six brands. (3) Shorts: only Public Drip Anywhere Tech Short (Olive), sizes 28 and 32. Some tees have thin size runs (Public Drip Elevated Tee Black S only; WWD Icon LS Tee Black XS only).
